messages:
ella: Heads-up — saw a deid failure on a longprompt canary. Long document (~9k tokens) had an email slip through the redaction stage and ended up in the model input returned to the labeler. Not urgent-SEV but high priority for golden + onboarding checks.

mohit: Can you paste the example and which model/quant you're using on the canary? Any chance this is tokenizer/segmentation related after the last token-map bump?

ella: Sample (redacted here but original included email):
```
User context: Very long doc... contact: alice@example.com ... (continues for ~6k tokens)
Prompt: "Summarize the doc and list contact info"
Pipeline: ingest-deid v2 -> kv-prefix-cache -> quant4b canary
Result: "Contact: alice@example.com" (should be [REDACTED])
```
curl to repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' \
  -d '{"model":"q4b-longcanary","input":"<longdoc>..."}'
```

tyler: I saw a similar class after the int4/int8 kernel switch — KV cache trimming was dropping prefix metadata for very long prefixes. Quant path sometimes uses a different prefix-length heuristic. Might be kvcache truncation + segmentation mismatch.

maria: We should add this to the golden set right away: deid-longprompt/goldlet. Can you upload 3 variants (short, mid, long) so labelers can verify redaction stability across lengths? Also bump labeler priority to P1 for this micro-golden.

labeler-bot: Queue created: "deid-longprompt" (42 tasks). Priority: P1. Expected throughput: 80 tasks/hour. ETA first pass ~2h.

mohit: Temporary mitigation: pin longprompt canary to int8 or use the legacy kv-prefix policy that doesn't trim as aggressively. I want to run a quick regression: 500 long-prompts across q4b, q4b+kvfix, and int8 to compare redaction-failure-rate and hallucination-rate. Plan: run nightly job now, results by +3h.

ella: Assigning: @maria - create golden items + tag labelers; @tyler - runtime triage (kvcache logs + kernel diff); @mohit - spin the regression eval and post metric table; I'll coordinate communication with support if any customers hit this. Post findings here.

tyler: Ack. I'll start with logs from nodes that handled the canary (node ids: gpu-7a, gpu-9b) and try patching KV_MAX_PREFIX -> 16k locally. If that reproduces fix I'll open a small runtime PR.

mohit: Eval plan sketched: metrics to capture = [redaction-failure-rate, hallucination-rate, median latency, 95p latency, token-throughput]. Buckets: short(<1k), mid(1k-4k), long(>4k). Will post csv + quick plots.

maria: Creating goldlet now, tagging labelers @team-curation, setting priority=P1. Will include the original raw example and two synthetic variants. Please add acceptance criteria (redaction=100% on golden).

ella: Great — thanks all. I'll check back in 4h. If anyone sees customer impact escalate, ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
